description: This PHP class 'EmployeeWorkExperienceAPI' provides API endpoints for managing employee work experience records, including CRUD operations such as get, create, update, and delete. It is part of the OrangeHRM human resource management system and interacts with services and data models to handle employee work experience data.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkExperienceAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints for managing employee work experience records in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEmployeeWorkExperienceService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmployeeWorkExperienceService instance.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee work experience record by employee number and experience ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all employee work experience records for a specific employee.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing employee work experiences.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new employee work experience record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new record.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Defines common validation rules for the request body used in create and update operations.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee work experience record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a record.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more employee work experience records.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for delete operation.

methods.name: saveEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Handles the creation or update of an EmpWorkExperience entity based on request data.

methods.name: getEmpNumberRule
methods.description: Provides validation rule for the employee number parameter.
